source: Visual review of 165 stations / 330 Google Street View panes, 2026-10-19; station IDs and panorama metadata in impl-e/references/stations.json. Sizes are visual estimates, OSM footprints retained. No imagery is a build input.

sections.name: Faros / lower 25is Martiou
sections.observation: Wide four-lane mouth, traffic lights, cross wires, commercial strip opposite; palms on the planted median; stone villa boundary inside Psychiko.

sections.name: 25is Martiou approach
sections.observation: Two-way double-white road, pale modern villas behind pine and cypress gardens; narrow marble kerbs.

sections.name: A square
sections.observation: Open lawn, low shrubs, mature pines, yellow-edged approach splitter; white kiosk on the Diamantidou exit; long stacked-balcony block opposite.

sections.name: Diamantidou
sections.observation: White flat-roof modernist villas and older tiled houses, continuous parked cars, pine canopy, palms in gardens and overhead utilities.

sections.name: B square
sections.observation: Low pale-stone garden perimeter and clipped shrubs; broadleaf and pine crowns; dark green kiosk with cream canopy on the Diamantidou arm.

sections.name: Upper Diamantidou / Eleftherias
sections.observation: Long white balconies, pines with bare leaning trunks, zebra crossings; green fencing and paved island at Eleftherias.

sections.name: Nikiforou Lytra
sections.observation: Narrow unmarked lane; rough pale stone walls, tall green metal fences, cypress spires and a few street trees.

sections.name: Paraschou descent
sections.observation: Steep narrow descent enclosed by low stone retaining walls with tall green/black railings; white balcony villas above the road.

sections.name: Dryadon / Pavlou Mela
sections.observation: Unmarked narrow residential links, trimmed hedges, white modern villas, blue directional signs and overhead cable.

sections.name: Davaki
sections.observation: Tall hedges, horizontal grey gates, white and cream flat-roof villas; distinct brown stacked balconies at the bend.

sections.name: Venizelou
sections.observation: Wide rising then descending avenue beside an open green linear island, pines and clipped trees, generous double-white markings and crossings.

sections.name: 25is Martiou / Stavrou
sections.observation: Narrow unmarked villa road, pale stone retaining walls, modern white balcony blocks, overhead wires; small planted Stavrou circle; long rough-stone school boundary approaching Bizaniou.

sections.name: Bizaniou / Athens College
sections.observation: Continuous rough pale rubble-stone campus wall on the left, dark railing above, pines and pale/yellow school buildings behind; green gates, bollards and utility poles.

sections.name: Korytsas
sections.observation: Parked cars tight against the kerbs, pines and climbing garden vegetation; short unmarked connection.

sections.name: Benaki
sections.observation: Tall rough pale-stone walls, a school gate with pale piers, cypress and pine spires; narrow paved margins with metal bollards.

sections.name: Areaki
sections.observation: High pale rendered/stone boundary to the right, bougainvillea spill, low villas behind pines, parked cars and cables.

sections.name: Michalakopoulou square
sections.observation: Small planted island with tall palms/pines and shrubs, kiosk and cream canopy at the Malakasi corner; metal pedestrian guardrails.

sections.name: Malakasi
sections.observation: Narrow lane with wooded verge, iron fencing and a high cream rendered property wall on the right; white apartment block beyond.

sections.name: Kallari park edge
sections.observation: Open pine-filled Alsos on the left behind a low fence/stone plinth; villas and garden walls to the right, parked cars and large kerbside pines.

sections.name: Lower Kallari
sections.observation: White modern villas, garden pines and palms, dense parked cars; pale entrance and tall cypress at the Elikonos bend.

sections.name: Elikonos
sections.observation: Narrow unmarked approach opening suddenly onto Kifisias signal; cream curved-corner office block with blue windows across the arterial.

sections.name: Kifisias carriageway
sections.observation: Three same-direction lanes, planted median and separator hedge, trolley wires, tall straight lamps, blue overhead road signs; glass-front offices and shop blocks opposite.

sections.name: Kifisias surface frontage / Faros
sections.observation: Narrow single-lane frontage beside divided arterial, steel separator rail, planted pine/oleander verge, commercial block across Kifisias, signals and open junction at Faros.
